mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 48 degrees at the Verona Area High School under clear skies and a full moon.

The city has announced that a segment of Highway M near the future Aldi location is closing for construction from October 5 through October 7. Traffic will be detoured to Old PB, East Verona Avenue, and South Main Street to allow for road improvements. Also, please remain vigilant against email scams posing as the City of Verona, as the city will never request fee payments via wire transfer.

There is plenty to do in town. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can head to Insight Wellness for yoga, and keep an eye out for trivia and the downtown Farmer's Market coming up Tuesday.

Looking at recent reports, on September 5, an officer discovered that several vehicles in the areas of North and South Main Street had been targeted by a viral social media prank that involved placing a slice of cheese on windshields.
Today's flavor of the day is Turtle, which is a local favorite. The store opens today at 10:00 AM for all your cravings.
